description: Prices an animated talking avatar before anything is spent: AI cost + Ania fee (+ own-image preparation, if any), returning a quoteId valid for ~10 minutes. Charges nothing. Use after agreeing the description, style and states (from list_styles) with the user. Show the price and wait for the user’s explicit go-ahead; never confirm for them.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

ownImageRef.description: Optional, from usar_minha_imagem; the price then includes the prep fee.
